claims.evidence: Four independent secondary tables agree identically (Young 2003, p. 420; Apologetics Press; bible.ca; merebible.com citing Smith 2018) + Skinner ICC pp. 134-135 printed table (full text read 2026-11-14). Von Gall text not directly consulted.

claims.claim: SP Lamech: 53 at Noah's birth; 600 after; total 653 (MT 182/595/777).
claims.evidence: Same convergence as clm-se-001; Skinner table line for Lamech (53, 600 | 653; MT 182/595/777).

claims.claim: SP differs from MT in only three places: Jared (62/785/847), Methuselah (67/653/720), Lamech (53/600/653).
claims.evidence: Same convergence as clm-se-001; all other figures identical across the tables.

claims.claim: SP creation-to-Flood total 1307; Jared, Methuselah, and Lamech each die AM 1307, the Flood year.
claims.evidence: Arithmetic from clm-se-001 + Young 2003 + Skinner table (death years 1307/1307/1307; Flood 1307).

claims.claim: Göttingen LXX prints Methuselah 167/802/969 (Gen 5:25-27).
claims.evidence: NETS Gen 5:25-27 read in full (based on Wevers 1974) + Young 2003 + Skinner table (167*/802*/969). Göttingen edition itself not directly consulted.

claims.claim: LXX (Göttingen) full table + creation-to-Flood total 2242.
claims.evidence: NETS Gen 5 read in full + Young 2003 table + Skinner table (Flood 2242).

claims.claim: On the 167 reading, Methuselah dies AM 2256 — 14 years after the LXX Flood (AM 2242).
claims.evidence: Arithmetic from clm-se-006 (birth AM 1287 + 969 = 2256; Flood 1642 + 600 = 2242); confirmed by Young 2003, Skinner table (death 2256), and adamtoabraham.com.

claims.claim: The 187/782 variant is attested in: Codex Alexandrinus corrector (Ac); Codex Cottonianus (D, via Grabe); Codex Coislinianus (M, 7th c.); Josephus Ant. 1.80-88; Demetrius the Chronographer; Eusebius Chronicon.
claims.evidence: Young 2003 + adamtoabraham.com apparatus summary (Wevers 1974, p. 106 image). Josephus/Demetrius/Eusebius via second-hand citation (Young/Smith; Wikiversity for Eusebius) — not directly consulted.

claims.claim: Whether 167 or 187 is the original LXX reading is debated.
claims.evidence: Wevers: 167 original; Smith 2017: 187 original; Young 2003: premature to decide; Hendel 1998: 167-to-187 plausibly prehexaplaric.

claims.claim: Papyrus 911 does NOT securely attest 187; Smith's 2017 claim was retracted in 2026; the reconstruction favours 167/802.
claims.evidence: adamtoabraham.com 2026-09-05 (updated 2026-09-28), endnote 12 (retraction) + line-length analysis; Schmidt & Sanders 1927, p. 279 (reconstruction 167, key digits conjectural).

claims.claim: 4QGen-b (4Q2) contains Gen 5:13 or 14 only — a single word, the name Cainan (qynn); text proto-MT.
claims.evidence: Young 2003 (citing Scanlin 1993, pp. 54, 141; DJD XII, pp. 31-37) + catalogue listings (Wikipedia Qumran Cave 4 list; khazarzar inventory). DJD XII pp. 31-38 not read directly.

claims.claim: 4QGen-b attests no genealogy numbers and no other Gen 4:25-5:32 verses.
claims.evidence: Negative result from clm-se-011's contents list (Gen 1:1-27; 2:14-19; 4:2-4; 5:13).

claims.claim: Seth = 'appointed/substituted' — the text's own wordplay from shith (to put, appoint) (Gen 4:25).
claims.evidence: BDB H8352 read in full (BibleHub, 2026-11-14).

claims.claim: Enosh = 'man,' with frail-mortal resonance.
claims.evidence: BDB H582/H583 (no gloss on the name itself; 'enosh 'man, mankind... especially opposed to God'); Cain's Descendants dossier via Keil ('weak, faint, frail').

claims.claim: Cainan/Kenan meaning: unknown; 'fixed' is Strong's only; 'smith/artificer' is Skinner's possibility via the Cain parallel.
claims.evidence: BDB H7018 silent on meaning; Skinner p. 131 ('possibly... 'smith' or 'artificer'... we have no means of judging').

claims.claim: Mahalaleel = 'praise of God.'
claims.evidence: BDB H4111 ('praise of God'); Skinner p. 131 (versions read participle 'Praising God').

claims.claim: Jared meaning: unknown; 'descent' is Strong's only; the angel-descent legend is 1 Enoch/Jubilees tradition, not lexical.
claims.evidence: BDB H3382 silent; Skinner p. 131 ('would signify in Heb. 'Descent'; hence the Jewish legend... Jub. iv. 15; En. vi. 6, cvi. 13').

claims.claim: Enoch meaning: uncertain; 'dedicated/initiated' is Strong's only.
claims.evidence: BDB H2585 silent on meaning (lists four bearers, incl. both Enochs).

claims.claim: Methuselah meaning: unknown; 'man of the dart' carries BDB's own '?'; 'when he dies, judgment' is folk etymology, absent from BDB.
claims.evidence: BDB H4968 ('*? man of the dart:* more probably Babylonian'); Skinner pp. 132-133 (Budde rejects; divine-proper-name view 'more probable').

claims.claim: Lamech meaning: unknown.
claims.evidence: BDB H3929 (no meaning; 'conjecture as to meaning BuUrgesch. 102, 129'); Strong's 'unused root of uncertain meaning'; Cain's Descendants dossier ('inexplicable from Heb. or even Arabic,' Skinner).

claims.claim: Noah = 'rest/comfort' — the text's wordplay in 5:29, labelled 'traditional etymology' by BDB.
claims.evidence: BDB H5146 ('Gen 5:29 (where traditional etymology)'); Skinner p. 133 ('Whether [Noah] be really connected with [nuach] 'rest' is very uncertain').

claims.claim: MT Gen 5 figures (all 32 verses) re-verified live this session.
claims.evidence: Preview API /api/bible/genesis/5/KJV, all 32 verses returned 2026-11-14, matching the Cain's Descendants dossier.

claims.claim: No dates for Gen 5; MT 1656 / SP 1307 / LXX 2242 are secondary constructions, none original.
claims.evidence: Westermann p. 353; Skinner pp. 134-136 (Cain's Descendants dossier §7).

claims.claim: Berossus ten-kings/ten-patriarchs correspondence collapsed; do not present the table as a live parallel.
claims.evidence: Westermann excursus pp. 349-353 (Cain's Descendants dossier §5.3).

claims.claim: Two Enochs, two Lamechs: distinct figures.
claims.evidence: clm-cd-007, clm-cd-009 (Cain's Descendants dossier).

claims.claim: Enoch's 365 years echo the solar year; Enmeduranki (Berossus 7th king) is the closest ancient parallel — analogy only, no dependence, no translation in the Babylonian material.
claims.evidence: Skinner pp. 131-132 (full text read 2026-11-14); Westermann excursus supersedes the wider table (Cain's Descendants dossier §5.3).

connections.note: The event's opening: Seth's birth, Eve's 'appointed' wordplay, Enosh, and the first calling on the LORD's name — the Sethite line's founding moment. Overlaps conn-cd-003 (Gen 4:25-26) and conn-ca-006 (Gen 4:25-5:3): this connection gives the founding moment as the event's own opening, distinct from the Cain's Descendants contrast reading and the Cain and Abel background link.

The event's core text: the ten-generation genealogy itself, with all three textual traditions' numbers. Overlaps conn-cd-004 (Gen 5:1-32) and conn-ae-005: this connection gives the genealogy as the event's core passage, distinct from the Cain's Descendants contrast reading.
The Cain/Abel narrative that precedes and motivates Seth's birth ('another seed instead of Abel, whom Cain slew,' 4:25).
The Cainite genealogy as the contrast list: same names (Enoch, Lamech), different figures, different trajectory — the two-lines structure.
The 'seed' promise as the theological frame for 'another seed' (4:25). Interpretive connection, not an explicit textual link: present as a reading, not as a stated link.
Noah's favour and righteousness — the genealogy's endpoint and the bridge to the Flood narrative.
New Testament reception of Enoch: 'translated that he should not see death.' Keep distinct from the Genesis text's own statement ('God took him,' 5:24).
Enoch 'the seventh from Adam' — counts the Sethite line, confirming which Enoch is meant.

The Chronicler's recap of the Gen 5 genealogy (Adam, Seth, Enosh, Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jared, Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech, Noah). Verse-existence verified live 2026-11-14 via the Preview API (correct book slug is the URL-encoded name, '1%20Chronicles'; the '1-chronicles' slug returns 404).

Luke's genealogy of Jesus traced back through Noah, Lamech, Methuselah, Enoch, Jared, Mahalaleel, Cainan, Enosh, Seth, Adam. Verse-existence verified live 2026-11-14 via the Preview API (Luke 3, 38 verses; vv. 36-38 as stated).
